name: BestskyTools
conditions: Free Listing ($0) requires embedding their 'Featured' badge on your website.
Free review takes up to 2 weeks; free tier gets 1 dofollow backlink.
requirements: AI and SaaS tools; the directory spans AI tools plus niche categories like Bluesky tools.
Sign-in is offered on the site (/auth/login) — the Submit flow likely requires an account.
SEO Growth Package explicitly requires 'Free product access for testing' for their review article.
preparation: Product name, URL, description, category, logo/screenshot assets.
The 'Featured' badge embed on your site if using the free tier.
Plan choice: Free (badge, ~2 weeks) / Premium $14.9 one-time (4 dofollow, 24h review, no badge, lifetime) / SEO Growth $59 (review article + 5+ backlinks; requires free product access for testing).
An account (sign-in link present beside Submit).
workflow: Go to https://bestsky.tools/submit (sign in first if prompted).
Submit tool details; free tier: keep the Featured badge live and wait ~2 weeks for review.
Premium: reviewed within 24h, no badge, lifetime listing.
watchFor: Badge requirement on the free tier is the gate; badge persistence rules are not spelled out.
SEO Growth's 'requirement: free product access for testing' means handing over product access if you buy the article tier.
Premium price shown as $14.9 one-time; SEO Growth shown $59 struck from $99 — promotional pricing.
Site also runs a paid 'boost domain rating' cross-promo (FrogDR badge in header).
countsAsLive: A public tool page at bestsky.tools/<slug> listed in All Tools and its category.
unknowns: Exact submit form fields (not fetched — likely behind sign-in).
Whether badge removal auto-delists the free listing.
